substitutions.perf: 100*clip(fps/120,0,1) from frame labels (no perf_score in real data)
substitutions.shield: GPU temperature >= 95C only (CPU channel missing pre-E5)
substitutions.gear: rows without an unmapped real gear excluded

perf_definition_caveat: fps-derived perf saturates once fps exceeds the target (every game row reads 100 here), and the spec defines non-game perf as responsiveness rather than frames, so the W0/W1 groups are not comparable under this conversion
verdict_reasons: perf saturates for every game row: target 120fps sits below the measured ~159fps, so the gain largely reflects a saturated perf term, not policy value
E4 shadow is dry-run: no actuation, so the replay cannot separate the policy's contribution from the environment (same reason c3 is BLOCKED inside P4)
cross-source comparison: real perf is derived from fps while the B2 anchor is a surrogate prediction over a frozen config - the two are not the same quantity
environment is not matched: real rows were collected in Beast gear on the high-performance plan, the B2 anchor carries no such state
shield test only sees the GPU (CPU channel absent), so the shield term is a lower bound
unlock: Return acceptance needs a policy-acted replay (a version that actually issues setpoints) or the live canary; this script stays a magnitude check.
